title: 'Yoroi Shin Den Samurai Troopers' Reveals Additional Cast, Second Promo
description: The official website of the Yoroi Shin Den Samurai Troopers television anime revealed additional cast and a second promotional video on Tuesday. title: New 'Keroro Gunsou' TV Anime Announced for Fall 2026
description: The official website for the Keroro Gunsou (Sgt. Frog) anime series announced a new television anime on Tuesday, revealing a teaser visual (pictured). The new anime adapting Mine Yoshizaki's comedy sci-fi manga is scheduled to premiere in Fall 2026. Yoshizaki began drawing the manga in Shounen Ace in November 1999. description: The official website for the television anime adaptation of Mika Yamamori's Uruwashi no Yoi no Tsuki (In the Clear Moonlight Dusk) manga revealed a pair of additional cast, staff, key visual (pictured), the theme songs, and second promotional video on Tuesday. description: The wraparound band on the 15th volume of Coffee's Wondance (Wandance) manga announced a live-action movie on Tuesday (pictured right). description: The 24th and final episode of Gachiakuta ended with an announcement on Monday that a second season is in production.
